clue.text: Carnivore seen around old Virginia?

indicators.note: the meat-eater is pictured surrounding the next piece, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: a wolf is a meat-eating animal

explanation.surface: A predator spotted prowling about the old state of Virginia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Virginia' reads as the US state, but the question mark points to a person: the novelist Virginia Woolf.
explanation.definitionFit: Surname of the modernist novelist whose first name was Virginia; the question mark flags definition by example.

clue.text: What's needed to endure the tedious opera

definitions.meaning: the quality of calmly putting up with delay or trouble
the Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera of 1881, which a bored listener might find a trial

explanation.surface: Sitting through a dull opera takes a lot of tolerance.
explanation.walkthrough: The two senses are the virtue of forbearance and the title of a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta; 'tedious' is a wry dig suggesting the opera itself tests the virtue.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbearance is what one needs to endure; separately, the title of a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera.

clue.text: Pen annihilated messed up jumbo

indicators.note: letters that are messed up are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: An enclosure wrecked by a clumsy elephant that has made a mess of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumbo is a common nickname for any elephant, after the famous circus animal; this is one Asian species.

clue.text: Moving loads of beer needing to mature

parts.note: porter is a dark style of beer
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: A brewery shifting casks of ale that must be left to mature.
explanation.definitionFit: Porterage is the work, or charge, of carrying goods and baggage from place to place.

clue.text: Cotton fabric's not OK in warm wind

indicators.note: the word not here says the following pair of letters is to be left out

parts.note: the chinook is a warm dry wind blowing down the Rocky Mountains

explanation.surface: A cotton garment is unsuitable when a hot wind is blowing.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe-s is 'is', a link. CHINOOK, the Rocky Mountain wind, loses its final OK.
explanation.definitionFit: A twilled cotton cloth, often khaki, used for casual trousers.

clue.text: Comfortably settle new arrangement for steel

indicators.note: an arrangement of the word steel puts its letters in a different order

explanation.surface: Settling comfortably into a fresh layout of steel furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: To snuggle down cosily is a way of settling in comfort.

clue.text: Tell friend to go round one drunk

indicators.note: the friend is told to encircle what follows, so it is placed outside it

parts.note: mate is British slang for a friend
I is the Roman numeral one
lit is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: Asking a mate to buy a round for someone already intoxicated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tell' looks like an order to speak, but it is the verb 'tell' meaning to carry weight, as in 'this will tell against you'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean to have an effect or weigh as evidence, as when facts count against a case.

clue.text: Insect burrowing into ordinary fruit

indicators.note: the insect digs its way inside the other word

parts.note: plain means ordinary or unadorned
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A bug tunnelling into an everyday piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy banana-like tropical fruit usually cooked before eating.

clue.text: Take on account and record first of transactions

parts.note: an EP (extended play) is a type of record

indicators.note: first of takes the opening letter of the word transactions

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper taking on an account and logging the first transactions.
explanation.definitionFit: To take on a task or offer is to agree to it or receive it.

clue.text: Demanding we must leave film like Brokeback Mountain?

indicators.note: the word we is told to depart, so those letters are removed

parts.note: Brokeback Mountain is set among cowboys, so it can be called a western, a film genre

explanation.surface: An insistent request that we walk out of the cowboy film.
explanation.definitionFit: A strict, exacting person is demanding in what they expect of others.

clue.text: Film artist takes look over plant

parts.note: cine is a prefix for film, as in cine camera
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: over here means turned over, so the word for look is written backwards

parts.note: an air is a look or manner

explanation.surface: A film artist casts an eye over a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns AIR (look, as in an air of confidence) into RIA.
explanation.definitionFit: A daisy-like flowering pot plant from the Canary Islands, grown for its bright blooms.

clue.text: In favour of charge before appearing? That's enterprising

indicators.note: before places the first pieces ahead of the next one

parts.note: to be for something is to be in favour of it
a ward is someone in one's charge
looking means appearing, as in looking well

explanation.surface: Supporting a charge before appearing in court shows initiative.
explanation.definitionFit: Planning ahead and embracing progress is a mark of an enterprising, progressive outlook.

clue.text: Lined with strip of a green light-emitting diode

parts.note: in lawn bowls a rink is a strip of the bowling green on which one game is played
LED stands for light-emitting diode

explanation.surface: A green-coloured strip lit by an LED along its edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green' is not the colour: it is a bowling green, a flat lawn for the British game of bowls, divided into strips called rinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A face marked with creases is lined; both describe skin furrowed by age.

clue.text: Fast data connection shortly to be installed in street

indicators.note: being installed puts the connection inside the other word
shortly says the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: wi-fi is a wireless data connection

explanation.surface: Broadband engineers about to fit a speedy connection in the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fast' looks like describing the data connection but is the definition. WIFI cut short gives WIF, installed in ST.
explanation.definitionFit: Swift is a synonym meaning quick or rapid.

clue.text: What was used to punish Great Train Robbers' aim?

definitions.meaning: an upright to which offenders were tied to be flogged
the 1963 Great Train Robbery targeted a Royal Mail train, so their aim was stealing (slang whipping) the mail

explanation.surface: A historical question about how the Great Train Robbers were punished.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1963 Great Train Robbery, a famous British crime, held up a Royal Mail train; 'whipping' is slang for stealing and 'post' is mail.
explanation.definitionFit: A post where offenders were flogged; read as two words it is the stealing of mail.

clue.text: Instruct hospital workers to avoid untruths

indicators.note: avoiding the untruths means leaving those letters out

parts.note: orderlies are hospital attendants
lies are untruths

explanation.surface: Telling hospital staff not to lie.
explanation.definitionFit: To instruct someone is to command or direct them.

clue.text: Got all fee when playing flute

indicators.note: letters at play are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A musician who received the full fee for playing the flute.
explanation.definitionFit: A small woodwind instrument of the recorder family, a kind of flute.

clue.text: Anticipate settling school by a year

parts.note: a prep school is a private preparatory school

explanation.surface: Paying school fees a year early.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay in advance is to settle a bill before it falls due.

clue.text: The cause to remember dropping off daughter and instrument

indicators.note: dropping off says the letter for daughter is shed

parts.note: to remind is to cause someone to remember

explanation.surface: A parent reminded to drop off their daughter and her instrument at school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping off daughter' sounds like the school run, but removes D from REMIND.
explanation.definitionFit: An electronic musical instrument played by moving the hands near two antennae without touching it.

clue.text: English must have stupid sounding moral rules

indicators.note: sounding means the word for stupid is taken as it is spoken

parts.note: thick is informal for stupid

explanation.surface: English people must have foolish-seeming moral codes.
explanation.definitionFit: An ethic is a set of moral principles governing conduct.

clue.text: Frank worried as the taker of an exam

parts.note: candid means frank
ate means worried, as in what's eating you

explanation.surface: Frank was anxious when he sat his exam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a name but is the adjective meaning honest.
explanation.definitionFit: A person sitting an examination is called an exam entrant or examinee.

clue.text: Not out? Not gay? One might view a post here

definitions.text: One might view a post here

parts.note: someone not out is home, at home
straight means heterosexual

explanation.surface: Personal questions about staying in and sexuality, then a hint about a view.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'post' is the winning post at the end of a racecourse, visible from the final stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: The final straight run of a racecourse, from which the winning post comes into sight.

clue.text: What actors go through, and so do great broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Actors pass through it, and so do great broadcasters.
explanation.definitionFit: The theatre's backstage entrance is the way performers come and go.

clue.text: Run up debts not looking for a solution

parts.note: to incur a debt is to run it up
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debts

explanation.surface: Running up debts without any thought of how to fix the problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking curiosity, someone uninterested in finding out the answer to anything.

clue.text: Regularly sicken inside like some diseases of the guts

indicators.note: inside puts those letters within the word for like some diseases

parts.note: viral describes diseases caused by a virus

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word sicken

explanation.surface: Some illnesses routinely make the stomach queasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Visceral relates to the viscera, the internal organs, meaning gut-level.

clue.text: Did fish mashed with head removed

indicators.note: with head removed says the first letter is cut off

parts.note: mangled means crushed or mashed

explanation.surface: A fish dish, mashed up with its head cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: To have angled is to have fished with a rod and line.

clue.text: Surely losing present home

parts.note: now means at the present time
in means at home

explanation.surface: Certain defeat facing whoever is at home right now.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-win situation is one where every outcome is bound to be a defeat.

clue.text: Treatment partially helping Andrei Kirillovich

indicators.note: partially means only part of the name is used

explanation.surface: A treatment that was partly helping a Russian named Andrei Kirillovich.
explanation.definitionFit: Reiki is a Japanese alternative therapy in which healing energy is channelled through the hands.
